links.outcome: Genetic condition identification accuracy across languages, including by language prevalence in training sources
links.effect: Significant differences in condition identification by translation method, condition, language, and model; accuracy of some models was more affected by language prevalence, script, and family.
links.quote: The accuracy of some models was more affected than others by factors like the conditions' literature prevalence, language script, family, and language prevalence.

unlisted_practices: Adaptive translation for select languages (did not improve translation or diagnostic accuracy with 3 tested LLMs; more effective with smaller LLMs in one language)

screen.reason: The study evaluates the impact of translation methods (NMT vs LLM translation, adaptive translation) on LLM diagnostic recognition of genetic conditions across numerous languages to assess safety and equity.
